tools.name: run_migrations
tools.description: Executes any database migrations that have not been applied yet. Migration files already recorded in the schema_migrations table are ignored. Read the instructions in docs/MIGRATIONS.md before you override the default advisory-lock timeout.

tools.name: list_ignored_paths
tools.description: Returns the glob patterns from .gitignore and .indexignore that the code indexer ignores. Use it when a file the user expects is missing from search results.

tools.name: get_system_health
tools.description: Reports CPU, memory and disk usage for one build agent. Read-only: it does not execute user-supplied commands and it never writes to the system.
